description: Project capital growth from reinvesting perpetual futures funding income (compounding carry). Use when user asks "how much will I make compounding 0.01% funding for 90 days?" or "what's my APY on this carry position?". Returns: finalCapital, totalEarned, apy, growthTable.

fundingRatePct.description: Funding rate per interval as percentage, e.g. 0.01 for 0.01%

reinvestPct.description: Percentage of earnings reinvested each interval. 100 = full compounding, 0 = no reinvestment. Default 100.

name: workflow.run_compound_funding
